input.summary:
P3 upper landing furnished in parts/room-23.mjs: a birch top-slab shelf with a flower pot on the west wall (the focal piece) and one hanging lantern at (43,11,10). Three blocks placed, no refusals or off-palette blocks; make.sh writes a whole build.nbt.
The landing's six floor cells are all lanes, so nothing stands on the floor; the light reads min 9 at the feet.
Walk and fit still flag the hall as having no way in, because the doors and the stair from the entrance are unbuilt in this partial build; re-check after the merge.
left: Walk verdict is UNREACHABLE in this partial build (no doorways or front entrance built yet); re-run `mcd room` after the merge to confirm the stair top (44,7,11) and the doorways at (42,8,10), (42,8,13) and (43..44,8,14) reach the six cells.
The fit check's 'hallway to nowhere' on this room is the same missing-entrance cause, not a furnishing fault.

Floor furniture is deliberately absent: the 2x4 hall is all lane, so a bed, table or dresser would block a doorway or the ladder foot; if the owner wants a dresser here, the shell's doorway plan must change first.

waste.what: Worked out which of the 6 floor cells are lanes by hand from the plan grid (doorway first cells, ladder foot, stair arrival, connectors) and the blank x44 z12..13 cells, to decide that nothing can stand on the floor.
waste.cost: about 5 minutes of coordinate reasoning across the plan's ROOMS, FLOORS, OPENINGS and stairs notes
waste.tool: `mcd plan` should mark the keep-clear lane cells (doorway first cells, ladder foot, stair arrival) as a distinct character, and list the stair hole cells it already omitted as blank

waste.what: Drew the layer array for layers() three times, each time with the wrong nesting (rows versus layers), before the placement was right.
waste.tool: a layers() example in the build library's docstring that shows a multi-layer list of rows explicitly, and an error when a flat row list is passed where layers are expected

waste.what: Verified the walk and fit results by reading the partial-build output, since the entrance and doors are not yet built, so the walk verdict cannot confirm reachability here.
waste.cost: 2 room/fit runs whose results are only partially meaningful
waste.tool: `mcd room --rooms` with a temporary entrance at the stair foot, or a `--from-merged` flag that runs the walk on the full merged build

companions.task: Confirm the stair top (44,7,11) and the step-out cell (44,8,11) against the ladder foot (44,8,10), and say whether the hole cells x44 z12..13 at y8 should be air or a stringer, before I fix the lane cells.

companions.role: carpenter (Schreiner) for a second look at the hall
companions.task: Decide whether a wall-hung shelf is enough for a 2x4 hall, or whether the owner's doorway plan should give up one lane so a small chest or coat stand fits.
